event: Nala asks to hunt with the guard spear rather than wait three days; Dray lends it, to bring back.

make.title: Watch Spear
make.description: A plain iron-headed spear on an ash shaft, taller than she is.

changes.note: Dray lends her a watch spear for the hunt

memory.fact: Dray lends Nala the watch spear for the hunt, to be brought back after.
Dray lends Nala the watch spear for the hunt, to be brought back after.

event: Hob's smithy: an open-fronted stone shed on the ford road, its forge glowing red at the back.

memory.fact: Hob's smithy is an open-fronted stone shed on the ford road, its forge glowing at the back.
Hob's smithy is an open-fronted stone shed on the ford road, its forge glowing at the back.
Hob Tarrant's smithy is an open-fronted stone shed on the ford road, its forge never let go out.

event: Rows of cold-iron nails and charms on the back wall sit in her sense as one flat, numb dead patch.

memory.fact: Cold-iron nails and charms hang in rows along the smithy's back wall.
Cold-iron nails and charms hang in rows along the smithy's back wall.
The rows of cold iron in Hob's smithy sit in her sense as a flat, numb dead patch.
The rows of cold iron in Hob's smithy sit in her sense as a flat, numb dead patch.

event: Huge Hob cups his right ear at her; she moves round to his right, and he hears her out.

memory.fact: Hob is deaf in his left ear; folk step to his right to be heard over the forge.
Hob is deaf in his left ear; folk step to his right to be heard over the forge.

event: Hob: a cold-iron boar spear on ash, three days, a silver bar; half now, half when he hands it over.

memory.fact: Hob takes half his price down on a commission, and the rest when the work is handed over.
Hob takes half his price down on a commission, and the rest when the work is handed over.

event: She pays with her silver bar; he counts twenty-five silver pieces back into her palm.

changes.note: Half a silver bar down to Hob for the cold-iron spear

memory.fact: Nala paid Hob half a silver bar down on a cold-iron boar spear, ready in three days.
Nala paid Hob half a silver bar down on a cold-iron boar spear, ready in three days.

event: She jogs back up the river lane, the watch spear in hand, the knapsack snug, past Marsh Croft.

changes.note: The Sea tops up her well

event: Above the croft the trail is plain: webbed prints in the mud, smears of grey slime on the stones.

memory.fact: Greymaw tracks are plain: webbed prints and smears of grey slime on the stones.
Greymaw tracks are plain: webbed prints and smears of grey slime on the stones.

event: A half-eaten ewe from last night's flight, and tufts of scaled fur snagged on the heather.

memory.fact: On the way up lie a half-eaten ewe from last night's flight and tufts of scaled fur on the heather.
On the way up lie a half-eaten ewe from last night's flight and tufts of scaled fur on the heather.

event: Toward noon, the screes: grey rockfalls below the corrie's lip, sheep bones at a deep cleft's foot.

memory.fact: The greymaw den is a deep cleft in the screes, rank with rotten salt and strewn with sheep bones.
The greymaw den is a deep cleft in the screes, rank with rotten salt and strewn with sheep bones.
The Tarn Screes are grey rockfalls below Hollow Tarn's corrie, two hours' climb above Marsh Croft.

event: On the skyline above stands a cairn hung with scraps of cold iron.

memory.fact: From the den mouth the cairn hung with cold iron shows on the skyline above.
From the den mouth the cairn hung with cold iron shows on the skyline above.

event: Within ten paces Undertow feels five sour knots through the rock, one favouring a leg.

memory.fact: Within ten paces Undertow feels a greymaw's rot as a sour knot, even through rock.
Within ten paces Undertow feels a greymaw's rot as a sour knot, even through rock.
The five greymaws left are together in the den through the day; one limps from the fight.
The five greymaws left are together in the den through the day; one limps from the fight.

event: They are sluggish, drowsing out the day; she edges up the scree and reaches the cleft unheard.

memory.fact: By day the five greymaws left lie up in the den, sluggish and ill-tempered until dusk.
By day the five greymaws left lie up in the den, sluggish and ill-tempered until dusk.

event: Pull and push in one surge: the nearest slides onto the driven point, and its chamber bursts.

changes.note: Surging pull and push through the den fight

memory.fact: A spear thrust driven by Undertow pierces greymaw scale; reaching the bone chamber, it kills.
A spear thrust driven by Undertow pierces greymaw scale; reaching the bone chamber, it kills.

event: The pack wakes snarling, slow and clumsy for their first heartbeats; only two can reach her at once.

memory.fact: Woken by day, greymaws are slow and clumsy for their first few heartbeats.
Woken by day, greymaws are slow and clumsy for their first few heartbeats.
The den cleft is narrow; no more than two greymaws can come at anyone in it at once.
The den cleft is narrow; no more than two greymaws can come at anyone in it at once.

event: She pushes one into the wall and pulls the next onto her spear; then the first, back onto the point.
The fourth scrambles over its dead; she spears it through the chest, jaws snapping by her face.
The limping one hangs back, then scrabbles out over the cleft's rim and away on three legs.

memory.fact: The limping greymaw hangs back, and if the fight turns it bolts up the scree for the tarn.
The limping greymaw hangs back, and if the fight turns it bolts up the scree for the tarn.
Nala speared four greymaws dead in the den; the limping one fled up the scree toward the tarn.
Nala speared four greymaws dead in the den; the limping one fled up the scree toward the tarn.

event: She runs it up the scree and crests the corrie lip a few heartbeats behind.
Below lies the tarn, black in grey crags, still as ink; no bird calls, the air smells of the sea.

memory.fact: Hollow Tarn is a black lake in grey crags; no bird calls there, and the air smells of the sea.
Hollow Tarn is a black lake in grey crags; no bird calls there, and the air smells of the sea.
No fish live in Hollow Tarn and no bird lands on it.
In still weather the tarn smells faintly of the sea, though the sea is two days west.

event: At the sight of it her well stirs and leans toward the water, like a tide drawn by the moon.

memory.fact: Within sight of Hollow Tarn, Nala's well stirs and leans toward the water, like a tide to the moon.
Within sight of Hollow Tarn, Nala's well stirs and leans toward the water, like a tide to the moon.

event: She runs the greymaw down on the east shore, where worn stone steps go down into the water.

memory.fact: Worn stone steps run down into the tarn on its east shore and on into the dark water.
Worn stone steps run down into the tarn on its east shore and on into the dark water.
On three legs the last greymaw is slow; Nala runs it down at the tarn's east shore by the old steps.
On three legs the last greymaw is slow; Nala runs it down at the tarn's east shore by the old steps.

event: She pulls it onto her spear; brine spills over the steps, and the last greymaw dies.

memory.fact: Nala killed the last greymaw by the tarn's steps; the whole pack of nine is dead.
Nala killed the last greymaw by the tarn's steps; the whole pack of nine is dead.

event: As she pulls, the tarn ripples toward her against the wind, and her well leans harder.

memory.fact: When Nala draws or pushes beside the tarn, its water ripples toward her against the wind.
When Nala draws or pushes beside the tarn, its water ripples toward her against the wind.

event: She saws off its right ear with the spear's edge; the steps go on down into the black.

memory.fact: Dray takes right ears as tally for the bounty, once his cart has found the carcasses.
Dray takes right ears as tally for the bounty, once his cart has found the carcasses.

event: Back over the lip, the tarn's pull fades with each step, and is gone once it drops from sight.

changes.note: Her well refills on the climb back from the tarn

memory.fact: As Nala walks away from the tarn its pull on her well fades, and is gone once it is out of sight.
As Nala walks away from the tarn its pull on her well fades, and is gone once it is out of sight.

event: In the cleft the four dead lie stiffening; she saws off each right ear: five in her knapsack.

memory.fact: The four greymaws killed in the den lie where they fell, already stiffening in the cold cleft.
The four greymaws killed in the den lie where they fell, already stiffening in the cold cleft.

event: The long walk down past the ewe and Marsh Croft; by mid-afternoon her throat is rough with thirst.
In the Reeve's yard four greymaw carcasses lie in a row, flies at them; Dray sits on his step.

memory.fact: Dray's cart came back by noon on day two with the four Marsh Croft greymaws; he has seen them.
Dray's cart came back by noon on day two with the four Marsh Croft greymaws; he has seen them.
On the afternoon of day two Dray is at the Reeve's house by the green, the carcasses in its yard.
On the afternoon of day two Dray is at the Reeve's house by the green, the carcasses in its yard.

event: She tips five ears onto the step; he counts twice. "The whole pack, in two days."

memory.fact: No cart climbs to the Tarn Screes; for kills up there Dray pays on the right ears alone.
After the white-eye, Dray takes Nala's word on the den kills without question.

event: A heavy purse and a cloth bag: eighteen pieces for nine heads, the watch's bar, a bar for the hunt.

changes.note: Dray pays 18 silver for nine heads, the watch's bar and a bar for the hunt

make.title: Heavy Leather Purse
make.description: A heavy leather purse, tied at the neck, that clinks when it moves.

changes.note: Dray pays her in a heavy leather purse

make.title: Small Cloth Bag
make.description: A small bag of plain cloth, drawn shut with a cord.

changes.note: Dray presses a small cloth bag of silver on her

memory.fact: Dray paid Nala eighteen silver for nine greymaws, the watch's silver bar and a bar for the hunt.
Dray paid Nala eighteen silver for nine greymaws, the watch's silver bar and a bar for the hunt.

event: He'll send two men and a pony up for the den carcasses, and burn them.

memory.fact: Dray will send two watchmen with a pony to fetch the den carcasses down and burn them.
Dray will send two watchmen with a pony to fetch the den carcasses down and burn them.

event: "The valley needs someone like you, Nala. The watch cottage by the ford stands empty. It's yours."

memory.fact: Dray offered Nala the empty watch cottage by the ford, hers if she will stay in the valley.
Dray offered Nala the empty watch cottage by the ford, hers if she will stay in the valley.
Reeve Dray will ask Nala to stay in the valley, and offer her the empty watch cottage by the ford.
